intro: At Stormwind’s main gates, Major Mattingly helps guard the capital and advises crafters on protection from dragons.

p: Major Mattingly is a high-ranking officer responsible for Stormwind City's landward defense. He stands watch in the Valley of Heroes under General Marcus Jonathan, alongside the city's garrison. His duties include overseeing gate patrols and travelers entering the city. Mattingly also knows the lethal nature of dragons and guides skilled crafters who seek to make protective dragonscale gear for facing dangerous lairs.
